You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From b3de274b05c75565d14ec2d665a8bbfe55a7fb16 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Nicolai=20H=C3=A4hnle?= <nicolai.haehnle@amd.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jun 2016 17:36:18 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] st/mesa: fix readpixels regression with MESA_pack_invert
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Fixes an error introduced in commit 3948cd37973696dc319170877382676809659465.

Reported-by: Marek Olšák <marek.olsak@amd.com>
Reviewed-by: Brian Paul <brianp@vmware.com>
Reviewed-by: Marek Olšák <marek.olsak@amd.com>
---
 src/mesa/state_tracker/st_cb_readpixels.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/mesa/state_tracker/st_cb_readpixels.c b/src/mesa/state_tracker/st_cb_readpixels.c
index 77c6332329..99d9cd59b0 100644
--- a/src/mesa/state_tracker/st_cb_readpixels.c
+++ b/src/mesa/state_tracker/st_cb_readpixels.c
@@ -520,7 +520,7 @@ st_ReadPixels(struct gl_context *ctx, GLint x, GLint y,
    /* memcpy data into a user buffer */
    {
       const uint bytesPerRow = width * util_format_get_blocksize(dst_format);
-      const uint destStride = _mesa_image_row_stride(pack, width, format, type);
+      const int destStride = _mesa_image_row_stride(pack, width, format, type);
       char *dest = _mesa_image_address2d(pack, pixels,
                                          width, height, format,
                                          type, 0, 0);
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by using an unsigned integer type (`uint`) for the `destStride` variable, which could lead to incorrect calculations when the stride value was negative. This issue was introduced in a previous commit and was fixed by changing the type of `destStride` to a signed integer type (`int`), allowing for proper handling of negative values.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by using an unsigned integer type (`uint`) for the `destStride` variable, which could lead to incorrect calculations when the stride value was negative. This issue was introduced in a previous commit and was fixed by changing the type of `destStride` to a signed integer type (`int`), allowing for proper handling of negative values.
